summary.en: U.S. index futures rose before Monday's open following a sharp selloff in Friday's cash session. The Chicago Fed's October activity index fell to -0.06 from September's revised +0.05, pointing to growth slightly below trend. Investors will watch Wednesday's October PCE and second estimate of third-quarter GDP, along with holiday-season consumer spending.
summary.zh: 周五美股现货大跌后，周一主要股指期货在开盘前回升。芝加哥联储10月全国活动指数由9月修正后的+0.05降至-0.06，显示经济增速略低于趋势。市场关注周三公布的10月PCE和三季度GDP第二次估算，以及假日购物季的实际消费表现。

title.en: Friday's selloff puts holiday spending in focus
title.zh: 周五美股大跌，假日消费成为本周焦点

impact.en: The S&P 500 fell 3.61% Friday. Reuters reported it was 11.6% below its October 6 peak, with technology shares down nearly 24.7% over the same span. Oxford Economics forecasts holiday retail sales growth of 4.2%, or 2.2% in inflation-adjusted volume. The forecast covers November and December and excludes autos, gasoline, bars, and restaurants.
impact.zh: 标普500周五收跌3.61%。据路透社报道，该指数较10月6日高点回落11.6%，科技板块同期跌近24.7%。牛津经济研究院预计11月至12月假日零售销售名义增长4.2%，扣除通胀后销量增长2.2%，口径排除汽车、汽油以及酒吧餐厅。

bullish: October retail sales rose moderately, according to the government data cited by Reuters. / 路透社援引的政府数据显示，10月零售销售温和增长。
bearish: A weaker equity market and higher borrowing costs could restrain discretionary holiday purchases. / 股市回落和较高的借贷成本可能抑制假日可选消费。

macroRisk.en: Black Friday spending will help gauge whether households are sustaining demand. Use the first spending figures as an early signal. The Oxford Economics forecast covers the full two-month period.
macroRisk.zh: 黑色星期五的消费表现有助于判断居民需求能否延续。首批消费数据只能提供早期线索，牛津经济研究院的预测覆盖完整的两个月。

title.en: Wednesday's PCE and GDP update anchor a shortened week
title.zh: 感恩节缩短交易周，周三聚焦PCE与GDP更新

impact.en: October personal income and outlays, which include the PCE price index, and the second estimate of third-quarter GDP are scheduled for Wednesday at 08:30 ET. HPE and Dell are among the technology companies with results due this week. U.S. equity markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving and close at 13:00 ET on Friday.
impact.zh: 10月个人收入与支出报告包含PCE价格指数，将与三季度GDP第二次估算一起在美东时间周三08:30发布。慧与科技和戴尔等科技公司本周将公布业绩。美股周四因感恩节休市，周五美东时间13:00提前收盘。

bullish: A wider equity advance after Monday's open would make the early tech-led rebound more credible. / 若周一开盘后上涨范围扩大，科技股带动的早间修复将更有说服力。
bearish: A firm PCE reading could keep rate sensitivity elevated during the shortened trading week. / 如果PCE读数偏强，缩短的交易周内股市仍可能对利率高度敏感。

macroRisk.en: The PCE release measures October prices, while the GDP update covers the third quarter. Treat them as separate releases and check the rate response as each becomes available.
macroRisk.zh: PCE报告反映10月价格，GDP更新对应三季度。关注这两项数据各自的公布结果及利率反应。

title.en: Chicago Fed activity index eases to -0.06 in October
title.zh: 芝加哥联储10月全国活动指数回落至-0.06

impact.en: The Chicago Fed scheduled the October CFNAI release for 08:30 ET. The official FRED series showed an 08:35 ET update with October at -0.06 and September at a revised +0.05. The latest reading indicates economic growth slightly below its historical trend.
impact.zh: 芝加哥联储安排在美东时间08:30发布10月全国活动指数。官方FRED数据库在08:35更新，10月读数为-0.06，9月修正为+0.05。最新读数显示经济增速略低于历史趋势。

bearish: The index crossed below its zero benchmark for trend growth. / 指标跌破代表趋势增速的零值。

macroRisk.en: The monthly reading can be volatile. Watch subsequent activity data for confirmation of a persistent slowdown.
macroRisk.zh: 单月指标可能波动，关注后续经济活动数据能否确认放缓持续。

note.en: The premarket supports a recovery attempt. Nasdaq-100 futures rose 2.99%, ahead of S&P 500 futures at 2.15% and Dow futures at 1.47%, compared with their own reference readings. Gold futures rose 2.56% and the dollar index gained 0.23%, so other markets still show mixed signals. The 10-year yield was about 4.92%, up 1.2 basis points. If participation broadens after the cash open and yields stabilize, the recovery has stronger support. A narrow advance with a firmer dollar would weaken that view.
note.zh: 盘前行情支持修复尝试。按各自参考值比较，纳指100期货涨2.99%，领先标普500期货的2.15%和道指期货的1.47%。黄金期货上涨2.56%，美元指数走高0.23%，其他市场的信号仍分化。10年期美债收益率约4.92%，上行1.2个基点。若现货开盘后参与面扩大且收益率企稳，修复判断将增强。若涨势集中且美元继续走强，则会削弱这一判断。
